applies_why: The judge text treats Matthew 1:20 as UNDERDETERMINED by citing two different answers or senses to that verse, which is the situation the rule governs.
quote: D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.: I weighed one reading, that two standing senses still permit UNDERDETERMINED because each side has an answer, against the other reading, that a two-sense verse is not open and so cannot be labeled UNDERDETERMINED on that basis.
why: The judge makes UNDERDETERMINED rest on Matthew 1:20 being answered in two ways, covenant presence versus physical source, but K-S2 says a verse with two senses at once is not open and both senses stand.
